actual: Code-path review after BUG-901 shows the R5 build-dataset-bridge parent command claims a BUILD_DATASET_BRIDGE operation for the batch and then DatasetBridgeService.build_until_stable_boundary creates and claims another BUILD_DATASET_BRIDGE operation for the same batch. The existing uq_advisory_historical_range_operation_running_type therefore deterministically rejects the internal operation exactly like the observed Outcome failure. Repair must distinguish batch-command and run/internal operation identities while preserving same-layer single-active enforcement, durable receipts, CAS/fencing, exact retry, and non-empty bridge semantics; do not remove or weaken the unique invariant.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
